Pinjari Jaheer Khan is a data analyst with a strong foundation in AI/ML automation, process optimization, and workflow development, seeking to leverage generative AI and automation in flight management operations. With experience in Python automation, AI tools, and data analysis using Excel, SQL, and Power BI, Khan has developed a range of technical skills, including programming languages, AI and automation tools, and data analysis and BI tools. Khan's experience includes a data analytics internship at Global Quest Technologies, where he gained hands-on experience with data analysis and visualization, and developed projects such as AI-powered flight data analysis and automation, and intelligent document processing with GenAI. Khan holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical and Electronics Engineering and has completed various certifications, including Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate. Overall, Khan is a skilled data analyst with a passion for AI and automation, looking to drive data-driven decision-making in flight management operations.
